entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-18
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Community contributors should use the `community` branch to develop using Visual Studio 17.14 #79948
  • LSP: Follow the spec for `$/progress` #79939
  • Negative span start in `SyntaxTreeDiagnosticEnumerator` #79935
    Backlog

Closed

  • Field keyword becomes an IInvalidOperation in OperationWalker #79201
    Next
  • MethodsJitted increase in recent Roslyn insertion #79919
    18.0
  • [Feedback] High CPU and Memory Usage by Roslyn Code Analysis in Latest Visual Studio Version #79921
    18.0
  • Using GeneratedRegex and DebugType as pdbonly/full causes source code hashing to use SHA1 #79913

PullRequests

Created

  • Redo how and when we report source generator telemetry #79951
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Update yml files to use community branch #79950
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Fix results streamed by ForAttributeWithMetadataName with multiple parts #79947
    Area-Compilers
  • Add tests for field keyword semantic model and IOperation #79945
    Area-Compilers
  • Add an async path for CPS to notify us about external build errors being reported #79943
    Area-IDE
  • Add AttributeUsage to EmbeddedAttribute #79942
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • ResxSourceGenerator: Changed the access modifier of the generated format methods from "internal" to "public" as it is with the generated properties. #79941
    Area-Analyzers, Community
  • ResxSourceGenerator: Added XML comment summary to the generated classes and properties to avoid warning CS1591 if they are public #79940
    Area-Analyzers, Community
  • Handled negative span start in SyntaxTreeDiagnosticEnumerator. #79936
    Area-Compilers, Community

Merged

  • Allow MEF components to supply assembly path resolvers #79218
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • update auto merge config #79949
    Area-Infrastructure, Next
  • Allow Razor to hook up the source generator in misc files #79891
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Update PublishData.json #79946
    Next

Updated

  • Fix failing test case BindingAsyncTasklikeMoreTests.Dynamic on Mono #79878
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Handle extension property reinference in object initializers #79739
    Area-Compilers
  • Fix stdlib inconsistency between core and fx compiler #79911
    Area-Compilers
  • Allow large InlineHint ArrayBuilder pooling #79857
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • *** WIP: Reduce allocations obtaining classified spans in ClassifierHelper #79856
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • *** WIP: Reduce allocations in AnalyzerDriver.TryExecuteSymbolEndActions #79855
    Area-Analyzers
  • Reduce allocations in DiagnosticDescriptor.GetEffectiveSeverity #79831
    Area-Compilers
  • Reduce allocations from calling ITypeSymbol.AllInterfaces #79817
    Area-Compilers
  • Reduce allocations in AssemblySymbol.GetTopLevelTypeByMetadataName #79810
    Area-Compilers
  • Reduce allocations in DeclarationComputer #79782
    Area-Compilers
  • Remove some code now that we've updated to a newer System.IO.Hashing package version #79667
    Area-Compilers, VSCode
  • Reduce alllocations in AnalyzerExecutor.GetAddDiagnostic #79657
    Area-Analyzers
  • Update AnalyzerConfig.cs s_propertyMatcherPattern regex key refactorization #78530
    Area-Analyzers, Community, Needs API Review, VSCode
  • Update AnalyzerConfig.cs s_propertyMatcherPattern regex key #78459
    Area-Analyzers, Community, untriaged, VSCode
  • ♻️ MSBuildWorkspaceDirectory - Fallback to AppContext.BaseDirectory when Assembly Location is empty #79934
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • Extensions: address some follow-ups related to `using` directives #79890
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
